senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Africa, Ἀφρική) Africa, esp. Northern A., the Africa Propria or Vera of the Romans. Y. Shebi. III, 36ᶜ bot. the Girgashite הלך לו לא׳ emigrated to Africa (Carthage). Ib. ‘a land like your own’ (II Kings XVIII, 32) זו א׳ that means A.; Lev. R. s. 17; Deut. R. s. 5.—
units: <cite ref="Tamid 32a:70">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>מדינת א׳</he>; (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:1">Lev. R. s. 27</cite>; Pesik. Shor p. 74ᵃ <cite ref="S01997"><he>קרטיגנא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="H00490"><he>חֹשֶׁךְ</he></cite>).
Lam. R. to I, 5. דוכוס דאפריקא Duke (military governor) of A. (Egypt &c.).—Denom. אַפְרְקִיִּים, ch. אַפְרִיקָאֵי Africans (Negroes).
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 21:16">Targ. II Chr. XXI, 16</cite>.
